items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: Well, they call it "Emmett Till had to stay on his own bottom."

ctx.x: Oh, I see. So that was the early Twenties. Let's back up some, while we have a little time on the tape. What I'd like to ask you is about the minstrel shows. What went on during a minstrel show? The usual minstrel performance, what did that involve? We talked a little bit before about the End Man, and you had comedy acts and that sort of thing. But what went on in a minstrel show at that time?

Well, they called it "Emmett Till had to stay on his own bottom." That means when you're working in a minstrel show, you've got to be able to take care of your own self and do your work, make the people happy. Because they call it entertainment.
